about: Where the marmot scout's joints are, for tools/rig-quadruped.py. Each point is [across, up, forward] in metres, measured on the model as it came from Meshy, standing on the ground: across is to its left, up is from the ground, forward is toward its nose. tools/joint-views.py draws the model on a grid to read these from, and draws these over it. "triangles" is how many triangles the mesh is thinned to: Meshy makes about 31,000, more than twice a hero. "character" picks the marmot scout's own clips in the script, in place of the cat's.
